headline: FlashVector reports agentic optimization across Unity Vector’s model-serving stack
summary: A September 2026 arXiv paper from Unity Vector AI Team and Stanford authors describes FlashVector, a closed-loop agent system that profiles, diagnoses, modifies and verifies changes across model-serving layers rather than only GPU kernels. The authors report deployment on Unity Vector production models, including up to 2.00× throughput and 1.98× latency speedup on model-server cases and a 1.6× feature-processing throughput increase at fixed latency SLO. The paper describes same-environment comparisons, a ±6% end-to-end baseline noise floor, correctness gates and full-stack load checks. These are author-reported results from one production setting; no independent reproduction, full-system code release or transfer study was verified.
